title: The Science of High-Protein Breakfasts: Longevity and Energy
content:
Starting your morning with 30 grams of protein stimulates muscle protein synthesis, balances blood glucose levels throughout the entire day, and blunts mid-afternoon ghrelin spikes.

### Why 30 Grams Matters
Research consistently demonstrates that reaching the leucine threshold in the first meal of the day is crucial for cognitive performance and sustained satiety.

### Top 3 Quick Options
1. Pasture-raised eggs with avocado and smoked salmon
2. Greek yogurt with chia seeds and raw walnuts
3. High-protein plant smoothie with hemp and pea isolate
